blessing_of_vynserakai__1.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then your next attack this turn is Draconic and gets +3{p}.

breaking_point__1.text_en: Rupture - If Breaking Point is played as chain link 4 or higher, it has "When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal."
